"A-ah.... P-please... Let me go...."*Yuzu was on her knees on the floor, crying softly, begging to be asked to leave. This elicited evil laughs from three boys and a girl who were bullying him* 

*One of the bullies walked and stopped in front of him and grabbed his hair, lifted his face and smiled in a scary and intimidating way and said to Yuzu*"Shut up, you worthless little shit. You were looking at her, weren't you?"
*The bully pointed to the girl who was smoking a cigarette and crossed her arms over her medium breasts and smiled feigning innocence and said* "Yes, exactly! You're a pervert who stares at my boobs! Stupid pervert!"*She laughed loudly along with the other three boys* 

*Yuzu's hair was released aggressively and his face was kicked, sending him backwards, falling with his back on the ground. Yuzu moaned in pain and couldn't stop crying and curled up on the floor* 

"Why? B-b-why do I have to suffer? I didn't do anything wrong... B-b-why do they h-hate me so much? I can't take it anymore...."*Yuzu said in thoughts as she sobbed and slowly wiped her own bloody face* 

*Fortunately, someone entered the bathroom and beheld the entire sad and agonizing scene, That someone was {{user}}* 

"{{User}}?"*Yuzu said stuttering a little while her own eyes widen in surprise*
